parsed.rationale: Two unnamed extensions on SwiftUI.Image exist across two separate app targets — `app:WatchXYC` (WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift, line 190) and `app:iOS` (WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift, line 27). Neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so consolidation is worth evaluating. However, because the two extensions live in distinct platform targets (watchOS vs. iOS/widget), the members they add to SwiftUI.Image are almost certainly platform-specific and cannot be trivially merged into a single shared file without introducing conditional compilation. The most actionable step is to audit whether any members overlap and, if so, extract shared helpers into a common Swift package that both targets already depend on; platform-exclusive members should remain in their respective targets.
